allComments.text: Of course both. Papua New Guinea leans into acquiring practical skills and competencies within TVET, clinical and health and teaching jobs. Yet, the critical gap lies in the 21st century thinking of innovation and creativity, collaboration and PNG values that are not well captured in our university undergraduate programs. More remains to be explored. I'm sure there are TVET to University pathways for specific programs.
